versions.short: The bill would allow the National Taxpayer Advocate, an official who represents taxpayers within the Internal Revenue Service, to step into lawsuits in United States federal courts about federal tax law as a friend of the court, called an amicus curiae. The advocate could only offer views on issues that may broadly affect taxpayers' rights, and a federal court could approve the advocate's request to take part. The change would take effect when the bill becomes law.
